Build Your Dream Home in Beautiful Orchard Park!

Rare opportunity to own .88 acres of vacant land in highly desirable Orchard Park, NY, located within one of Western New York’s top-rated school districts. Situated on Ellicott Road, this spacious lot offers approximately 159.20’ x 240.80’ of frontage and depth, providing ample room to design and build your custom dream home.  Owner can hold the mortgage 

Property is located to the left of 5033 Ellicott Road and offers a peaceful setting with convenient access to shopping, restaurants, parks, and major roadways while still maintaining a private, residential feel.  

Utilities available at the road include electric, gas, water, and sewer.

Please note: Property is located in an AE Flood Zone. Additional flood insurance may be required by a lender, or the site may need to be built up depending on intended use and building plans. Buyers are encouraged to conduct their own due diligence with the town and appropriate professionals regarding zoning, permits, utilities, and building requirements.


Don’t miss this chance to create your ideal home in one of Orchard Park’s most sought-after locations!
